newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as cenbnk intervenes.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends flat as cenbnk intervenes.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 472.75/473.75 bolivars per dollar in a busy session that saw the Central Bank cover strong dollar demand, traders said.
"The Bank has been supplying between 80 and 85 percent of the market's dollars," said one trader. "That's what has kept the rate so stable in recent days," he added.
Traders said demand for dollars had stemmed as much from businesses as from the interbank market.
